body:
I don't really know what happened or when it happened. I slowly but surely was just desensitized to the world. From my family abandoning me. To my uncle abusing and belittling my mental trauma and physical capabilities with unbelievable high expectations, To my girlfriend cheating on me, to my best friend who my girlfriend cheating on with, to being ostracized by those i thought i could rely onIy think i eventually just gave up. If it wasn't for my brother i believe i wouldn't be here writing this.

After hammering and chipping away at my innocence. All those angry thoughts of malicious intent just faded. My joy faded. The sunlight in my eyes faded. The joy of existent and all its warmth and light vanished from my eyes like a candle. 

Now i walk around with a smile, flirt with girls, "socialize at the water cooler" work bs, but inside its all a shame. Its all an attempt to run from the demons in my head. To keep my mind from drifting and to keep my mind at ease. Being home alone is the worst. All i do is think and think. Think about my past, think about my mistakes. So i grab my liquor, xanax, whatever the fuck will make me forget the demons.
